concepts_present.evidence_quote: Mask R-CNN extends Faster R-CNN by adding a branch for predicting an object mask in parallel with the existing branch for bounding box recognition.
We propose a layer called RoIAlign that removes the harsh quantization of RoIPool.
Mask R-CNN is conceptually simple: Faster R-CNN has two outputs for each candidate object ... we add a third branch.
We adopt the same two-stage procedure, with an identical first stage (which is RPN).
Anchors are inherited from Faster R-CNN's RPN.
We use FPN as a default backbone.
We use ResNet and ResNeXt networks of depth 50 or 101 layers.
Loss is L = L_cls + L_box + L_mask.
We evaluate on the challenging COCO dataset ...

concepts_absent.rationale: Mask R-CNN inherits the anchor-based design of Faster R-CNN.
Standard cross-entropy + smooth-L1 + per-pixel sigmoid for masks; no focal.
